$comment: engine.airport (MOD-075 / FEAT-096, §MP; §44; §46; §33; §32; §18) — the Heathrow-class international airport data contract. Every tunable figure the airport module consumes — the airport-tier ladder (milestone + cost), and each tier's runways, per-runway pax rate, terminal gates, per-gate pax rate, access tier, tourism-reach multiplier, freight-apron t/day, blight class, noise-contour radius, noise level, land footprint, jobs, rail-spur requirement and surface-access-reduced throughput percentage — lives here, never as a Go literal in internal/engine/airport/*.go (GR#15).

meta.spec: §MP (M11 + regional airport achievement, 5B capex, 4 runways, ~200k pax/day, huge noise contour + its own motorway/rail spurs); §44 Holiday Tourism (airport tiers step-change reach: domestic → continental → global); §46 FDI (aerospace campus needs airport adjacency + runway access); §33 The Freight Harbour (air cargo joins the conserved-tonnes identity); §32 The Blight Model (the airport is one of the seven named blighting-object classes); §18 Wellbeing (noise as a mental-health driver).

units.milestone: milestone tier (M-number; the §4 milestone ladder the tier unlocks at)
units.costMillions: millions of pounds (£M) — placeholder build cost for ladder ordering
units.paxPerRunwayPerDay: passengers per runway per day (pax/day per runway) — the per-runway slot rate
units.paxPerGatePerDay: passengers per gate per day (pax/day per gate) — terminal processing capacity
units.accessTier: tourism access-tier rung (domestic | continental | global) — §44's step-change ladder
units.reachMultiplier: tourism-reach multiplier (dimensionless) — the §44 reach figure handed to engine.tourism
units.blightClass: blight ordinal (low | moderate | high | severe) — §32's general-blight class
units.contourRadiusM: noise-contour radius (metres) — the blighting-object contour radius
units.noiseLevelDBA: noise level at source (dBA) — §18's noise driver
units.requiresRailSpur: whether the tier requires its own rail spur (boolean) — §MP 'its own motorway/rail spurs required'
units.surfaceAccessReducedPct: percentage of full throughput when the required surface-access spur(s) are absent (percent)

meta.ladderNote: This file is the AIRPORT-TIER LADDER — regional_airport (domestic) -> continental_hub (continental) -> heathrow_class_international_airport (global) — the same two named entries data/buildings.json already carries (regional_airport at entries[140], heathrow_class_international_airport at entries[218], 'M11 + regional airport ach'). This feature EXTENDS those entries with mechanics, never forks them (ASM-668): the regional tier mirrors the catalogue entry, the heathrow tier carries §MP's 4 runways and ~200k pax/day, and the continental hub is the middle rung of §44's domestic → continental → global reach ladder.
meta.balanceNote: EVERY numeric figure below — milestone, cost, runways, pax rates, gate counts, reach multiplier, freight-apron t/day, blight class, contour radius, noise level, land footprint, jobs, rail-spur requirement, reduced-throughput percentage — is a COARSE DIRECTIONAL PLACEHOLDER pending Aaron's balance pass (standing balance-number regime). No junior-invented final figure satisfies any AC; tests check direction/structure only (more runways => more pax; a tiered airport out-reaches a regional one; without surface access throughput degrades), never a pinned magnitude.
